step1_figure.circuit_type: Rail-to-rail input comparator with decision circuit and output buffer
step1_figure.description: A general-purpose comparator consisting of complementary PMOS and NMOS differential input pairs for rail-to-rail common-mode range feeding a cross-coupled NMOS decision circuit with level-shifting, followed by a PMOS differential buffer and CMOS inverter output stage.

open_loop_gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain of the comparator around the switching threshold

equation.formula: A_v = d(v_out)/d(v_p - v_m) = A_preamp * A_decision * A_buffer
equation.explanation: Calculated as the maximum slope of the DC transfer curve around the trip point. In the text, the gain is reported as approximately 175,000 (105 dB) for a 5V process.
equation.assumptions: Quasi-static DC sweep with fine voltage resolution around threshold

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 at VDD=1.8V: Pre-amp gain ~ gm_n*(ro_n || ro_p) ~ 15-20 V/V; Decision circuit gain ~ 10-25 V/V; Output buffer diff-pair + inverter gain ~ 100-200 V/V. Total open-loop voltage gain Av = 15 * 15 * 150 = 33,750 V/V (~90.5 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Channel length modulation in SKY130 (0.18um/1um) reduces individual stage output resistances compared to older long-channel technologies.

systematic_offset.description: Systematic input-referred DC offset voltage of the comparator

equation.explanation: Difference between the input voltage at which the output crosses VDD/2 and the reference voltage vm.
equation.assumptions: vm = VDD/2 = 0.9V, nominal process without random mismatch

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to single-ended conversion in the PMOS output buffer diff-amp and finite gain of preceding stages, systematic offset is typically 0.5 mV to 3 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Asymmetric loading in the output buffer current mirror causes a small systematic offset referred to the input.

propagation_delay.description: Propagation delay from differential input zero-crossing to digital output transition (50% to 50%)

equation.explanation: Time difference between the input crossing the reference voltage and the output switching to logic threshold.
equation.assumptions: 50 mV input overdrive, 10 ns input pulse, load capacitance < 50 fF

sky130_expected.calculation: In Baker text, delay is ~9 ns in a 1-um CMOS process. For SKY130 with fT higher by a factor of 4-5x and parasitic capacitances lower (~10-20 fF per node), the expected delay under 50 mV overdrive is ~1.5 ns to 4 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled node capacitance and higher transconductance at 130nm significantly speed up node charging.

equation.explanation: Hysteresis width determined by the ratio of cross-coupled to diode load transistors in the decision circuit. When beta_B = beta_A (W5=W6=W7=W8), hysteresis is zero.
equation.assumptions: beta_A = beta_B in Fig. 27.9 (no intentional hysteresis designed)

sky130_expected.calculation: Since W5=W6=W7=W8=10, beta_B/beta_A = 1.0, yielding theoretical VSPH = 0V and hysteresis = 0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed symmetrically without positive feedback width boosting; slight difference arises only from numerical simulation step.

power_supply_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD including bias circuit and comparator stages

equation.formula: I_DD = I_bias + I_diff_nmos + I_diff_pmos + I_decision + I_buffer + I_inv
equation.explanation: Total current supplied by VDD during normal quiescent operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bias generator branch: ~15 uA. NMOS input pair: Iss=20 uA. PMOS input pair: Iss=20 uA. Decision circuit: 20 uA. Buffer stage: 15 uA. Inverter leakage: < 1 uA. Total IDD ~ 80 uA - 120 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Supply scaled from 5V down to 1.8V, tail currents scaled to ~20 uA per stage for reasonable power/speed trade-off.

input_common_mode_range.description: Allowable input common-mode voltage range over which the comparator operates correctly

equation.explanation: Rail-to-rail input range achieved through complementary parallel NMOS and PMOS differential pairs.
equation.assumptions: Complementary input pairs active across entire 0 to VDD range

sky130_expected.calculation: At VDD = 1.8V, PMOS pair operates down to 0V; NMOS pair operates up to 1.8V. Linear range spans full 0V to 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Complementary inputs ensure at least one pair is in saturation from rail to rail.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig. 27.9 rail-to-rail comparator measuring open-loop gain, systematic offset, quiescent supply current, and propagation delay under 50 mV overdrive.
